answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is forfeited when an audited task reveals duplicated control or fabricated work. Audits can be triggered by a random sample of counterparties, with rewards paid from the seized bond. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes mass Sybils costly because each identity needs locked capital, and each failed claim risks losing it. An oasis of cheap accounts can become a fable when one audit starts a spiral of bond losses.
